title: Which exception terminates logprune.py for --keep 90m
prompt:
Our ops runbook (and the README in this repository) says that any bad `--keep` value passed to `logprune.py` is rejected by argparse with its usual usage error. Last night someone ran

    python3 logprune.py --keep 90m /var/log/app

meaning 90 minutes. Going by the code in this repository, which exception class actually terminates the program for that command? (For reference: when argparse rejects an argument it prints the usage error and raises `SystemExit`.)

Answer with just the exception class name.
